note: Wayne County forest east of Piedmont with an archery range and a rifle/pistol and shotgun range. The camping spot is a dirt clearing beside the gravel loop parking lot just north of Route B, by the archery range; the area's unimproved roads may not be signed and their condition varies. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: area page 'Camping: Open Camping - Walk-in/Float-in/Backpack; Designated Camping Sites'; brochure 'Primitive camping is permitted', 14 days in 30; map (4/3/2019) Primitive Camping + Parking + Archery Field Target north of Route B = GIS 487 beside gravel loop lot 525. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights written manual. Pin (GIS 487) on an open dirt clearing - fine. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit': 'Camping: Open Camping - Walk-in/Float-in/Backpack; Designated Camping Sites'; 'This area has unimproved roads that are open to public vehicles. These roads may not be shown on area maps or posted with signs. Road conditions may vary.' Brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted. Campers are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period. Groups of 10 or more campers need a special use permit... Vehicles are restricted to public roadways and parking lots unless otherwise...' The map (4/3/2019) legend has Primitive Camping; one symbol, with Parking Lot and Archery Field Target, on a short spur north of Route B; GIS point 487 (Type 'Primitive Camping Area'). Imagery: a gravel loop lot ~60 x 40 m (lot 525) ~65 m SW of the point; the point is on an open dirt clearing at the end of a dirt spur, with archery-course tracks around it. A designated spot beside a gravel lot, not a ramp lot: stays. A 23-ft rig fits the loop lot; the dirt spur at the point is narrow. No ford/4WD/rig wording.
PIN: stored 37.14037,-90.61192 = GIS 487, on the open dirt clearing (not under canopy). Fine; the loop lot is 37.13979,-90.61236 if AWH prefers the gravel.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): no water near the camp; only small streams in the woods.
PHONE: area page and brochure '(573) 663-7130' (Ellington office) match.
Note rewritten: acreage, generic MDC text, the 14-day limit (now booking.max_stay_nights), 'site length not published' and directions dropped; where the camp is and the unimproved-road caveat put in.
